C1.note: the universal-interface objects and the behavioral parameter kappa live in SIDE-kernel; this kernel neither defines nor imports them, and the federation forbids a Lake cross-dependency
the Euler balance equation at a prime, SIDE-kernel`s definition; absent from this kernel

C1.form: register 3: totality of realization through places
C1.note: the mechanisms and the place-to-mechanism reflection are category-shaped objects of the corpus, with no formal counterpart here

C1.form: register 4: the balance-to-positivity distance at the multiplicative place
C1.note: its sign form IS h2_sign; the DISTANCE as a number is not defined in the kernel -- the row states the sign form only
C1.statement:
def h2_sign : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, classK k → 0 ≤ poleTerm k - primeSum k + archTerm k

C1.note: no operator, spectrum or realization map exists in this kernel
the archimedean channel lambda_A is not constructed here; ITS SUM lambda_n >= 0 IS STATABLE, as li_form

C1.statement: def li_form : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ liCoeff n

C1.form: the cell form m(a) >= 0 on an admissible family
C1.note: the family is a PARAMETER: the ladder`s B-spline windows are not constructed as Lean functions
C1.statement:
def cell_form (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (W : Set ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ W, 0 ≤ archTerm (F a) - primeSum (F a)

def h2_sign : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, classK k → 0 ≤ poleTerm k - primeSum k + archTerm k

C2.name: h2_sign_imp_cell
C2.statement:
theorem h2_sign_imp_cell (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (W : Set ℝ) (hF : admissible F W) :
    h2_sign → cell_form F W := by
  intro h a ha
  have hk := h (F a) (hF a ha).1
  have e : poleTerm (F a) - primeSum (F a) + archTerm (F a) = archTerm (F a) - primeSum (F a) := by
    rw [(hF a ha).2]; ring
  rw [e] at hk
  exact hk
